provisional.title: These warnings are computed against limits we estimated ourselves
provisional.message: The server does not publish the thresholds these signals are checked against. Measured on the real plant, gauge pressure spends 92 % of the time below its «minimum», so a pressure warning from this screen may mean nothing. The server's own alarms override this screen: their limits were set by whoever knows the process.

forecast.title: Accumulated wear

idle.body: Accumulated wear is computed over weeks of history, not over the present instant: it means reading the historian for five signals and splitting the range, so it takes a few seconds. The risks above do not depend on this and are already evaluated.

resolution.title: This measures what is sustained, at a resolution of {{resolucion}}
resolution.message: Each sample is the average of its interval, so an episode shorter than {{resolucion}} is averaged away and does not show up here. A 0 % means «nothing sustained happened», never «nothing happened». Hours are estimated from the fraction of samples, not counted: this plant's historian has gaps. And «with the pump delivering» is reconstructed from flow rate, because motor load has no series of its own.

forecast.unwatchedNote: These wear mechanisms are not being watched, because the historian does not serve the signal they need. It is not that they do not happen: it is that nobody is counting them.
